lines: Amane
「I see...... So it was you, Kotarou.」
Come to think of it, it wasn't surprising.
There were a limited number of people who knew of the existence of the Fuuma head family's hidden mansion.
If it was Danjou's son, Kotarou, then he had probably at least been informed of its location.
Fuuma Kotarou
「It's...... Amane-san, isn't it?! It's been a really long time, so I couldn't tell for a moment, though......」
The boy's eye suddenly lit up brightly, but it soon wavered with confusion.
It was too sudden a reunion.
And, the fate of the Fuuma clan had changed drastically over the past few years.
He couldn't even bask in the simple joy of it――and that went for Amane too.
Kotarou
「Um...... I was worried. 'Cause I heard that after that revolt, Amane-san left the village......」
Amane
「That doesn't matter. What are you doing here?」
Kotarou
「Eh?」
Amane
「This is the Fuuma head family's hidden mansion. It's the place where, in days gone by, the warriors of the clan used to discuss their dreams of independence.」
Amane
「It stores many ninja tools to serve as preparations for battle, and there are also special books recounting the history of the clan.」
Amane
「You may be Danjou-sama's son, but...... this isn't a place that a child like you should be entering so lightly.」
Kotarou
「Uh, well...... I know that, but...... there are some reasons for it......」
Amane
「Reasons? Like what?」
Kotarou
「U-Umm......? What, you ask... It's nothing major......」
Amane
He was extremely evasive.
Feeling suspicious, she looked closely, and clutched in Kotarou's hand was a book with a picture of a man and woman intertwined on it.
Amane
「Y-You――?!! Is that a Bedroom Art handbook?!!」
Amane
「Were you hiding here to look at those obscene things in secret?!!」
Bedroom Arts were ninja arts which employed a union between a man and a woman――in other words, ones related to sex.
Kotarou
「Huwaah??! Uhh, no, this is――」
Looking further, all manner of indecent books and drawings were spread out on the floor around the boy, too.
Amane
「I'm stunned. To think you would awaken to your sexuality at your age――No, should I be celebrating it with “That's Danjou-sama's bloodline for you”?」
Kotarou
「N-No, that's not it!! It's nothing like that. This is just because of a desire for knowledge――」
Amane
「Desire for knowledge? Given that, you're awfully interested in women's bodies, aren't you?」
Amane
「You've read it in detail, and even put sticky notes on it, haven't you? Like here. And indeed here, and here――」
Kotarou
「Uh, well...... Um, Amane-san, that's too close......」
Amane
「Close? What's too close?」
Kotarou
「Well, your face, and...... y-your boo...... No, it's nothing......」
The boy made his face red and averted his eye from Amane, who approached him forcefully with the instruction book in hand.
It seemed that he was in the midst of puberty, and there were some things he couldn't say out loud.
Amane
「Hmph. Ridiculous! The rumours about you being an empty-headed “Diot” were true, hmm?」
Kotarou
She muttered as if spitting it out, at which point he sharply stiffened his body.
Amane had run away from Gosha, and yet she had heard what Kotarou, the “current head of the family”, was called.
Kotarou
「Th-That's right...... I'm the incapable “Diot”......」
Kotarou
「That's why I've been hiding here and reading books......」
Amane
Kotarou
「If I go back to the mansion now, I'll be scolded by Tokiko......」
Kotarou
「No, well...... I'm at fault for skipping out on my ninja art training, though......」
Kotarou
「But that's pointless...... I can't use ninja arts...... So even if I train......」
Kotarou
「Since that's the case, I was sure reading books on ninja arts here would...... be more useful......」
Amane
「Hmm.」
The boy cast his eye downward and muttered lonesomely as if speaking to himself.
Amane
（He's changed quite a bit, hasn't he......?）
She had last met Kotarou when he was just a child.
Back then, he had been cheerful and overflowing with intelligence, and had certainly shone as the “clan head's child”.
But now, that shine had darkened unrecognizably.
The reason was――well, she didn't even have to think about it.
The “Diot” who couldn't use ninja arts.
That fact had probably dealt the boy's mind a deep wound that would not be easily healed.
Amane
（......But, that has nothing to do with me anymore.）
Amane
「―――They've arrived, huh?」
Kotarou
「Amane-san......?」
Ignoring him and his confused face, Amane stood up.
Signs of shinobi approaching the hidden mansion had reached her sharp ears.
Amane
「I thought I could buy a little more time, but...... Rotten as they may be, they're still “his” minions. It looks like they're not stupid.」
Kotarou
「A-Are you being chased by somebod――Hey, Amane-san?! That wound!!」
The boy opened his eyes wide.
Amane's right foot was horribly broken, looking like the flesh was bursting out from the inside.
Amane
「......You keep hidden here, idiot. We can't afford to dirty the head family's library with some lowlives' blood, can we?」
She said over her shoulder, and dragged her right foot, which she couldn't move properly, back upstairs.
